The feature is a **delete action for pending bills**. It is the change in commit `db22701b986ae73bc876df2327fa0f82a7fd3ed5` ("(feat) Add delete action for pending bills (#717)", by Nethmi Rodrigo, 2026-04-22). I found no ticket key for it: the commit message, body and PR title have no `O3-` reference, and a search of the billing app's `src` for `O3-\d+` found nothing. Nothing in the code ties the feature to abandoned visits specifically. It applies to any bill whose status is `PENDING`.

- **What it does:** It calls `DELETE bill/{uuid}?reason=...` through `deleteBill(billUuid, reason)` (`openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/billing.resource.ts:256-262`). The same file already had `deleteBillItem` for line items (`:248-254`), which is separate.
- **Where it is offered:**
  - On the invoice page, as a "Delete bill" danger button shown only when the bill is pending. On success it navigates back to the billing home (`openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/invoice/invoice.component.tsx:147-153` and `:252-268`).
  - In the bill history table's overflow menu, as a "Delete bill" item shown only for pending bills (`openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/bill-history/bill-action-menu.component.tsx:17-53`).
  - Both open the `delete-bill-confirmation-modal` route (`openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/routes.json:138-141`, registered in `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/index.ts:135-136`).
- **What the user must supply:** A reason for deletion, entered in a required text area of up to 255 characters. The Delete button stays disabled until the trimmed reason is non-empty. The modal warns that the action cannot be undone (`openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/modal/delete-bill-confirmation.modal.tsx:15-93`).

Later commits (`bfc75902`, O3-5743) added a Finalize action on pending bills, and `dcfacea4` (O3-5200) restricted line-item edits to pending bills. Neither added the delete action.
